label: Late copy phase (step >= 13) of long sequences, content-sparse
explanation: Fires almost only in the copy phase (100% of activation mass), and only late in it: absolute step t >= 13, which in practice means L = 7..9 (L=9 holds 65% of mass, L=8 30%) and recall_idx >= 5. Firing rate climbs with t (5% at t=13, 16% at t=14, 27% at t=15, 33% at t=17). Silent in the original phase, at the delimiter, at short L (3-6), and early in the copy phase. Within the late window it fires on only ~18% of eligible steps, and which steps it picks depends on sequence content in a spread-out way. There is a modest boost when k was seen earlier (prev_tok k lift 4.2x, out_tok k lift 5.8x; adding seen(k) gives precision 0.30 but recall 0.40). Top activations often have repeated tokens next to each other (w w k, k k k), but in_count >= 2 does not predict firing. The timing predicate covers about 96% of activations and 98% of mass, but precision is only about 0.18.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the previous input (most: k, d, c, r, 2, w; least: i, <DEL>, 0, g) and the token being output (most: k, p, w, r, a, m; least: i, h, 0, -); timing cues that raise it most: to_go=0, recall_idx=5, t=15.
